scope: CPU qualification of real archived actions in an author-controlled failure family. No new model attempt, GPU, or claim that the injected label explains the observed failure.

local_case_selection.rationale: Two small but distinct integer/natural divisibility statements and one finite-divisor computation. Admit only with exact archived prelude, immutable target header and review of source to execute. p138 is a domain-diverse reserve if source-safe.
local_case_selection.same_family_positive_preferred: p40_bad.state0 if an exact author accepted source with the same p41 prelude is admitted. Otherwise explicitly state the positive source and changed context.

evidence_tiers.archive_exact_failure: The archived safe command or artifact under the pinned original scope fails again, with the actual compiler category compared to the original. A recreated negative control is identified separately.
evidence_tiers.finite_support: Bound only the enumerated observed commands or module snapshots. A matched scope and exact admitted input set are required to claim that this named support does not close. Missing, unsafe, unresolved and timed-out paths remain unknown. Cross-trajectory arbitrary recombination is outside a one-module finite enumeration.
evidence_tiers.strong_controls: Whole-target standard automation, bounded library signature retrieval, ordinary in-proof algebra, and ordinary local auxiliary declaration splits with unchanged target and original imports. Compare under existing Lean process modes, charging initialization, attempts and diagnostics. Independently authored CPU proof controls are explicit oracle proposals, not a learned model or novel constructor.

model_gate: At least two independent source targets must establish a measurable gap beyond existing legal library retrieval, ordinary author-style split/rewrite, and exact search over named evidence. A manually found proof, compiler API failure, mismatched import or unexecuted candidate does not on its own prove such a gap.
intake_decisions_fixed_before_cpu: Keep the D3.9 outcome label as a selection factor only. Never expose upstream complete reference proof bodies to new proposal or retrieval arms. Known reference bodies are restricted to explicitly labeled offline positive controls.
